input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no limitation-of-liability provision anywhere. Searches for "liability", "damages", "aggregate", "indemnif", "limitation", "disclaim", "exceed" and "consequential" return only the no-joint-venture wording in 10.2 ("assume or create any obligation, liability, or responsibility on behalf of the other") and the Termination Payment formula in 4.2(a); the Warranties section (9) contains only mutual authority representations and the Globix acknowledgement, and General Provisions (10.1-10.8) covers notices, joint venture, assignment, waiver, governing law, severability, survival, entire agreement and headings. There is therefore no cap, no basis of calculation and no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages, so both parties (including the Company) are exposed to unlimited liability, and none of the fallback elements (mutual 12-month fee cap; uncapped indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct) is met. Because the clause is genuinely absent we drafted at the preferred level, inserting a new Section 10.9 within Section 10, which survives for two years under 10.7, using the playbook model language with the fee basis tied to amounts payable by the Company under Section 3.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 10.9 (Limitation of Liability): mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, mutual waiver of indirect/consequential damages, and uncapped Excluded Claims.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no liability provisions at all, so we have added a mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000, together with a mutual waiver of indirect and consequential damages. Consistent with our playbook, indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security breaches, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP sit outside the cap, and the Company's payment obligations are not capped damages; we can fall back to a mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.

ops.text: Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, (a) neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, and (b) each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (ii) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000). "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligation to pay amounts due to HDI under this Agreement shall not be considered damages subject to this Section 10.9.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
